name: MemCan
author: lklimek
description: Self-hosted MCP server and Claude Code plugin that gives coding agents persistent, searchable memory across sessions: lessons, decisions and preferences, per-project TODOs, indexed coding standards and semantic code search. Runs locally on LanceDB, fastembed and Ollama.
access: Public, MIT licensed. Self-hosted: install the Claude Code plugin from the lklimek/agents marketplace and run your own server; there is no shared instance.
